channels.explanation: Increase google by $322/day (+30%): fitted curve revenue = 7.54 * spend^0.92 (loglog_ols, n=30, R2=0.8826); marginal ROAS 3.95 at current spend -> 3.87 at recommended spend.
Decrease meta by $291/day (-30%): fitted curve revenue = 11.59 * spend^0.75 (loglog_ols, n=30, R2=0.8821); marginal ROAS 1.59 at current spend -> 1.74 at recommended spend.
Decrease amazon by $31/day (-5%): fitted curve revenue = 9.69 * spend^0.82 (loglog_ols, n=30, R2=0.8623); marginal ROAS 2.45 at current spend -> 2.47 at recommended spend.

summary: Reallocating $2,618/day toward google and away from meta, amazon is projected to lift daily revenue by $698 (+8.3%). Marginal ROAS is equalised across channels where floors/caps allow.
method: power-law response curves (log-log OLS) + greedy marginal allocation
